decisions.statement: A gap a spacing step has is reached by name rather than written out again.
A dimension is judged in Swift and nowhere else.
A labelled gap and a labelled least length and a labelled stroke width are dimensions.
A number a padding is handed without a label is a dimension.
A label handed anything but a number is no dimension.
A number inside a string is no dimension.
A number inside a line comment is no dimension.
A dimension is the kind of dimension that dimension is together with the number written.
A width a thing is drawn at is judged as a distance between two things is.
A gap named across and a gap named down are the kind a gap named plainly is.
A grant names one file and the values Alan let that file have.
Each value a grant names has a reason.
A grant reaches only the file the grant names and only the values the grant names.
A grant names its file by the page with that file rather than by a path.
How many times a granted value is written in its file is not counted here.

definition: the check refusing a gap or padding written out rather than taken from a spacing step
